citation.title: Two-scale topology optimization of multiscale structures and materials via deep neural networks for local and global buckling
citation.authors: Sobhan Honarvar; Nolan Black; Ahmad R. Najafi
citation.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering, vol. 458, article 119038
citation.version_coded: abstract only, recovered via search-engine snippets of the (otherwise access-blocked) publisher abstract; no full-text route could be reached

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract states that a neural surrogate predicting homogenized microscale properties, used inside a two-scale buckling-constrained topology optimization loop, achieves about a 10,000-times speedup over direct finite-element-based analysis.
claim.key_phrase: achieves about 10^4x speedup over direct FE-based analysis
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: Stated directly in the abstract as 'about 10^4x speedup over direct FE-based analysis' (recovered via search-engine snippets; the superscript formatting was not perfectly preserved in every extraction, but 3 independent search snippets agreed on '10^4x' / '10,000x'). Not independently verified against the full text.
claim.alternatives: None identifiable without the full text; the abstract gives only this one comparison.

notes: Access exhausted every legal route found: (1) DOI resolved to the Elsevier/ScienceDirect landing page (linkinghub.elsevier.com -> sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0045782526003117), which returned HTTP 403 to automated access. (2) OpenAlex marks this as hybrid OA (CC-BY-NC on the publisher's own site) but its recorded pdf_url is null and its abstract_inverted_index is empty (no abstract available from OpenAlex); Crossref's metadata for this DOI likewise had no abstract field. (3) No arXiv or other preprint version was found; a similarly-themed arXiv paper on buckling-constrained multiscale TO (arXiv 2505.04353, 'Yield and Buckling Stress Limits...') was checked and is a different work by different authors (Christensen, Wang, Sigmund), not a preprint of this article, so it is not a duplicate. (4) Drexel University pages for corresponding author Ahmad Najafi (faculty page, lab page) list this publication but link only to the blocked ScienceDirect page; Najafi's Academia.edu page returned HTTP 403. ResearchGate copies appeared in search results but were not opened (excluded route). No CAPTCHA, Cloudflare check, login or paywall was bypassed anywhere; no personal data, email, mailto parameter, API key or login was used. The abstract text itself was recovered only indirectly, through search-engine result snippets of the publicly viewable (but script-blocked) publisher abstract; this is coded as access = abstract_only rather than no_access because that abstract text, though not independently confirmed verbatim from the publisher page itself, was consistent across three separate search queries. All R1-R4 are 'na' ('no full text'), per the access rules. The screening decision is kept as include (I-SPEED, since the abstract's only comparison is an explicit speed/cost figure against a classical direct-FE computation) rather than excluded, per the access rules. included.stratum is set to 'none' rather than 'speed', per the record validator (audit.coding.validate_records), which treats stratum as undetermined for any record that is not read in full text; the abstract-level content still points to a speed-type primary outcome (see claim fields). physics is coded 'other' because the article's central mechanical criterion is buckling (elastic stability), which is not one of the listed physics categories (compliance, stress, thermal, compliant_mechanism, multiphysics, metamaterial_homogenization); dim is 'unclear' because the abstract does not state 2D vs 3D. No author named Jun Wang (authors: Sobhan Honarvar, Nolan Black, Ahmad R. Najafi). No duplicate of this title/DOI was found elsewhere in audit/pool/pool.csv.
